name: Aim Punch Tweaker
teaser: Change the amount of aim punch, and remove that darned blur!
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
About

Hate that aim punch that sends your PMC’s aim into orbit whenever you get hit by a PM round?

Well no more!

This mod is client-sided that allows you to easily tweak the aim punch intensity by a percentage with the F12 config menu. This mod also automatically removes the blur effect that appears on the screen, but you can enable that back on if you so desire.

Installation

Drop the CreamCheese-AimPunchTweaker .dll file into BepInEx/plugins/. Or just extract the zip folder into your main SPT directory, that work’s too!

Compatibility

Ifyou’re using another mod that changes the aim punch values client-side (ie. through BepInEx plugins),IT WILL CONFLICT.

It doesn’t mean the mods can’t work together, you’ll just get odd results, or this mod or the other mod will cancel out each other.

This does indeed work with SPT Realism.

My Recoil Tweaker mod has the ability to turn off aim punch if you want as well, but if you want to use this mod instead, disable the option in the Recoil Tweaker config or GUI.

Have fun!
